text:
sophia: Quick synthesis from this quarter's recurring incident scan — noticed 4 high-frequency signatures: autoscaler lag (esp during ramp), model cold-start tail latency, intermittent DB connection spikes, and deploy rollouts that bypassed canary rules. Putting a proposed action bundle here for owners + timelines. :spiral_calendar:

mike: Agree on the top items. Can we prioritize autoscaler + pre-warm first, that's causing most customer-facing latency spikes. :+1:

raj: I ran the heatmap yesterday, autoscaler lag accounts for ~42% of P95 regressions across infra incidents. Will paste query we used soon.

emily: For cold-starts, we should consider a small pool of warm replicas for high-QPS models and an LRU eviction policy. Also we need better observability on KV cache misses.

alice: Deploy bypasses — I found 3 rollouts where canary flag was accidentally set to 100% in the release script. I'll add a git hook and a CI check to block that.

zach: DB spikes — Ops traced them to a sched storm on the analytics job we run at 03:00 UTC. Short-term: move heavy jobs to a shifted window. Medium-term: rate-limit analytics queries to the read replica.

sophia: Proposed action items (brief):
- A1: Autoscaler tuning + pre-warm policy, owner: mike, due: 2026-04-15
- A2: Model warm pool + KV cache tracing, owner: emily, due: 2026-05-01
- A3: CI guard for canary % and release script audit, owner: alice, due: 2026-04-08
- A4: Analytics job reschedule + read-replica rate-limit, owner: zach, due: 2026-04-10
- A5: Recurrence catalog + signed-off remediation playbooks, owner: raj, due: 2026-05-05

mike: I'll draft the autoscaler plan and a canary fallback rule. Quick ask — do we want a hard limit on rollout concurrency?

emily: Yes, set rollout concurrency to 10% per minute for critical services and a hard fallback to previous model if error rate > 3% within 5m.

alice: Creating a pre-commit check for the release script now, will push a PR this afternoon.

raj: Here's the query I used to pull recurrence counts (Splunk):
```
index=prod_logs service=inference "error=timeout" | stats count by failure_signature | sort -count
```
That gave me the top signatures over the last 90 days.

zach: I'll take the scheduling change and coordinate with data-platform. ETA for cross-team sync: 48h.

oncall-bot: Reminder: please add any ongoing incident mentions to the recurrence tracker – https://redwood.internal/incidents/recurrence-catalog

mike: Quick note on rollout guard — propose a dashboard alert that triggers when canary ramp accelerated more than 2x the configured rate. Who can pair on the alert?

emily: I'll pair with you, mike.

ops-bot: Created tracker ticket REC-2387 for "autoscaler lag — tuning & pre-warm" and assigned to mike.

sophia: Thanks team — action owners, please update the recurrence-catalog page with status and add PR/Jira links as you progress. We'll review progress in next ops-ops review on 2026-04-20. :eyes:

alice: PR for CI guard is up: https://github.com/redwood/release-scripts/pull/612 — includes a test to prevent 100% canary via script.

mike: Draft autoscaler plan at https://docs.redwood.internal/ops/autoscaler-tuning.md, WIP comments welcome.

raj: I'll start the playbook template for recurring signatures and include remediation runbooks + postmortem link.

emily: Added KV cache tracing instrumentation ticket JIRA-7412.

zach: Analytics job moved to 04:30 UTC in testing; will validate this week.

sophia: If nothing else, owners please ack here once tasks are closed. We'll convert open items into follow-up issues if timelines slip.

mike: ack (will update REC-2387 as I progress).

emily: ack (tracking JIRA-7412).

alice: ack (PR merged).

zach: ack (testing schedule change).

raj: ack (playbook draft started).

sophia: Great. Closing thread for today — will repost a short status digest before the April ops review. :wave:
